manifest.name: geo-content
input_files: file-backed fixture: strict content brief JSON and optional replayable source_content snapshot
manifest.rollback_boundary: Remove generated content run directories and revert content, CLI, registry, packaging, and geo-content together.

frontmatter.name: geo-content
frontmatter.description: Create evidence-lined GEO titles, explainers, neutral comparisons, method-backed rankings, page blueprints, refinements, and article-friendly Markdown. Use for title generation, 科普/解释、对比、榜单、页面蓝图、内容优化, and article-friendly rewriting. Excludes unsupported factual claims, winner declarations without like-for-like evidence, network research, publishing, and live ranking measurement.

interface.short_description: Create offline evidence-lined GEO content artifacts
interface.default_prompt: Use $geo-content to create the requested content mode, preserve evidence lineage, and surface source gaps.

required.mode: title | explainer | comparison | ranking | page-blueprint | refine | article-friendly

optional.evidence: unique labels; claim and absolute source_uri required; entity, dimension, and numeric score optional
optional.source_content: inline text or safe relative UTF-8 file object up to 2 MiB
optional.evaluation_method: non-blank string or strict object with name, criteria[{name, weight}], and optional score_scale; tie_breaker is rejected in v0.1

permission_contract.filesystem: read inputs and write selected runs root
